note.question: How do simultaneous and sequential compare for optimal assortment recommendation in multistore retailing?
note.overview: This paper studies a multistore assortment planning problem in which a seller centrally decides the assortment of products in each store. Each store is visited by a certain fraction of customers. Upon arrival, customers observe the products offered in the current store.
